title: Reduced dominant part over a general Noetherian base
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The closed subset $C_f\subseteq X$ is the closure of the inverse image of the set of generic points of $S$ [def-sc-generic-point]. The reduced dominant part of $X$ over $S$ is the reduced induced closed subscheme on $C_f$ [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme] [def-pc-reduced-scheme], equipped with its canonical closed immersion into $X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion].

source.place: Expose II 1.2.5, printed p. 25: reduced union of components whose generic points map to generic points of the base.
